# Sample app

One workload in its own subscription: a spoke network peered with the hub, a subnet with its own network security group, and a storage account only that subnet can reach.

<!-- Generated by scripts/update-readme.sh from the compiled template. Edit the @description and @metadata decorators instead. -->

| | |
|---|---|
| Version | `1.1.0` |
| Use it | `using 'br/platform:solutions/02-workloads-000-sample-app:v1.1.0'` |
| Deploys at | subscription scope |

## Parameters

| Parameter | Required | Type |
|---|---|---|
| [pContext](#pcontext) | yes | [contextType](#contexttype) |
| [pHub](#phub) | yes | [hubVnetType](#hubvnettype) |
| [pAddressPrefix](#paddressprefix) | yes | string |
| [pSecurityRules](#psecurityrules) | no | [securityRuleType](#securityruletype)[] |
| [pStorageSku](#pstoragesku) | no | [storageSkuType](#storageskutype) |
| [pContainers](#pcontainers) | no | string[] |
| [pDnsServers](#pdnsservers) | no | string[] |

### pContext

Where the workload is deployed.

- Type: [contextType](#contexttype)

### pHub

The hub to peer with. The platform stack owns it; this stack owns both halves of the peering.

- Type: [hubVnetType](#hubvnettype)

### pAddressPrefix

Address space of the spoke. The app subnet gets the first /26.

- Type: string
- Example: `10.10.16.0/24`

### pSecurityRules

Security rules for the app subnet.

- Type: [securityRuleType](#securityruletype)[]
- Default: `[]`

### pStorageSku

Redundancy of the storage account.

- Type: [storageSkuType](#storageskutype)
- Default: `Standard_ZRS`

### pContainers

Blob containers in the storage account.

- Type: string[]
- Default: `[]`
- Example: `["uploads"]`

### pDnsServers

DNS servers of the spoke. Empty uses the Azure-provided DNS.

- Type: string[]
- Default: `[]`
- Example: `["10.10.4.4","10.10.4.5"]`

## Types

### contextType

Where a resource is deployed. Every module takes it as pContext.

| Property | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| environment | yes | [environmentType](#environmenttype) | Environment short name, used in every resource name. |
| location | yes | [regionType](#regiontype) | Azure region of the resources. |
| tags | no | object | Tags added to every resource. Example: `{"workload":"sample-app","owner":"platform-team"}` |

### environmentType

Environment short name. Each environment has its own management group hierarchy and subscriptions.

- Type: string
- Allowed values: `dev`, `prod`

### hubVnetType

The hub virtual network a spoke peers with. The platform stack owns it; a spoke only references it.

| Property | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| subscriptionId | yes | string | Subscription of the hub. |
| resourceGroupName | yes | string | Resource group of the hub. Example: `rg-hub-prod-szn-001` |
| name | yes | string | Name of the hub virtual network. Example: `vnet-hub-prod-szn-001` |

### regionType

Azure regions this platform deploys to. Each one has a short code in regionCode().

- Type: string
- Allowed values: `switzerlandnorth`, `switzerlandwest`, `westeurope`

### securityRuleType

One rule of a network security group.

| Property | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| name | yes | string | Rule name. Example: `allow-https-from-vnet` |
| priority | yes | int | Priority between 100 and 4096. Lower runs first. Minimum value: 100. Maximum value: 4096 |
| direction | yes | string | Traffic direction. Allowed values: `Inbound`, `Outbound` |
| access | yes | string | Allow or deny the traffic. Allowed values: `Allow`, `Deny` |
| protocol | yes | string | Network protocol. Allowed values: `*`, `Tcp`, `Udp` |
| sourceAddressPrefix | yes | string | Source address prefix or service tag. Example: `VirtualNetwork` |
| destinationPortRange | yes | string | Destination port or range. Example: `443` |

### storageSkuType

Storage account redundancy.

- Type: string
- Allowed values: `Standard_GZRS`, `Standard_LRS`, `Standard_ZRS`

## Outputs

| Output | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| oResourceGroupName | string | Resource group of the workload. |
| oStorageAccountName | string | Name of the storage account. |
